name: Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoicing
standard: Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoicing SDK, invoice v1.0
why_no_rules: The ETA checks run inside the oe_einvoice_eta module as rules einvoice_clearance.eta_document_readable, eta_parties, eta_header, eta_lines, eta_totals, eta_advisory and eta_profile, on invoices that go to clearance. They are not part of a project rule set.
covers: ETA v1.0 JSON document built from a finance invoice
Calculation rules checked before the document leaves
Issuer and receiver identification by tax registration number
Signing with the company eSeal through a pluggable signer
source_note: Facts ETA does not publish (the person receiver threshold, the EGS code format) are advisory checks and never block.
review_status: Provisional. Tested against the SDK sample documents; not yet cleared against the live ETA environment by an Egyptian taxpayer.
